exposure: treatment methods (dilatation and curettage (D&C) only, methotrexate and D&C, D&C with Foley catheter ballooning, invasive procedures such as uterine artery embolization, hysterectomy, and open resection)
outcome: likelihood of opting for invasive procedures
successful treatment with D&C without transfusion
favorable treatment without adjuvant therapy and transfusion
cohort: The study participants were 128 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who received treatment at Korea University Ansan Hospital from November 2002 to December 2022.
finding: Early gestational age, younger maternal age, and sonographic hypervascularity were independently associated with favorable treatment for Cesarean scar pregnancy without adjuvant therapy and transfusion.
gest_age: Not specified, but early gestational age at diagnosis was identified as a predictor for favorable treatment outcomes in Cesarean scar pregnancy.
